motion.name: state-shift
motion.purpose: Communicate focus and route selection without decorative lift.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: One explicit next action in an operator workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #2bd7c5; border-radius: 8px; background: #2bd7c5; color: #040a12; font: 700 12px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #66e5d8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a2f2e9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #22354a; border-radius: 8px; background: #0e1d2e; color: #f2f7fc; font: 700 12px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #2bd7c5; color: #2bd7c5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2bd7c5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: State Chip
components.description: Explicit status label with redundant text and semantic color.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #276a42; border-radius: 6px; background: #0b1725; color: #5ad28f; font: 750 10px Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; }

components.name: Control Panel
components.description: Bounded operational group with tonal depth but no shadow.
components.html:
BUNDLE DEPLOYMENT

Provider, model and runtime binding are ready for review.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #22354a; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0e1d2e, #0b1725); color: #f2f7fc; font: 500 13px/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-panel strong { color: #8da0b8; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .11em; }

components.name: Route Navigation
components.description: Stable text-first navigation with one cyan current route.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 6px; background: #07111d; } .ds-nav button { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #8da0b8; font: 700 12px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button:hover, .ds-nav button:focus-visible { border-color: #22354a; color: #f2f7fc; outline: none; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { border-color: #2b556b; background: rgba(43,215,197,.12); color: #2bd7c5; }

components.name: Resource Fact
components.description: Persistent footer fact derived from Hypervisor telemetry.
components.css: .ds-resource { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 150px; padding: 10px 14px; border-right: 1px solid #22354a; background: #091522; color: #f2f7fc; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-resource strong { color: #8da0b8; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .11em; } .ds-resource b { font-size: 17px; } .ds-resource span { color: #8da0b8; font-size: 10px; }

narrative.overview: AiDN is a dense, calm operational surface rather than an AI chat product or decorative monitoring screen. The active Hypervisor, stable navigation, Bundle execution chain, and real resource state remain legible before any secondary workflow.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent Hypervisor identity and resource truth.
Dense but bounded panels; no fake charts or decorative telemetry.
Cyan signals selected route and active local context.
Mobile preserves access to Hypervisor selection and Advanced Mode.

rules.name: The One Route Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks the current operational path, not general decoration.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Depth Rule
rules.body: A panel gains visual weight from a real operational role or persistent location, never from a colored glow.

dos: Do keep Bundle as the central deployment workspace.
Do keep Endpoint offers, Validation, and Sessions as distinct canonical workflows.
donts: Don't use a market offer as the default representation of local Hypervisor health.
Don't use sparklines, progress rings, or colored glow as stand-ins for operational evidence.
Don't edit deployed Bundles in place.
